response.sql:
WITH source_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(p.fundflux, '<missing>') AS funding_source,
        AVG(ss.boxy / NULLIF(ss.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
        COUNT(*) AS size
    FROM projects AS p
    JOIN scanspatial AS ss
      ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
    WHERE ss.boxy IS NOT NULL
      AND ss.boxz IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, '<missing>')
),
with_average_size AS (
    SELECT
        funding_source,
        avg_ratio,
        size,
        AVG(size) OVER () AS average_size
    FROM source_metrics
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    SUM(size) AS combined_size,
    AVG(size - average_size) AS avg_excess_size
FROM with_average_size
WHERE size > average_size;

assumptions.assumption: “Size” means the number of spatial scan records contributing a non-missing boxy/boxz ratio for each funding source; a zero boxz is excluded because the ratio is undefined. The missing funding source is grouped separately from actual source values using the sentinel '<missing>'.
